title: Day 1/100: Everyone Thinks Windows CMD is Dead... Until This! 👀🔥 #Shorts #Windows11
description:
Everyone thinks Windows Command Prompt is dead until they see what real developers actually use it for 👀🔥

Most people only know "dir" and "cd"… but real developers control their entire PC with these 5 terminal secrets:

1. netsh wlan show profile name="NAME" key=clear (Extract saved Wi-Fi key)
2. curl wttr.in (Live ASCII weather radar in terminal)
3. systeminfo (Instant CPU, RAM, & Windows build specs)
4. tree /F (Visual ASCII project folder tree structure)
5. code . (Launch VS Code workspace in 1 second)

If this made you understand the Windows terminal better, SAVE IT for later 📌
